title.narrative: Business Environment Reform and Institutional Strengthening

description.narrative: The Albania Business Environment Reform and Institutional Strengthening Project aims to assist the Government to: (1) facilitate business entry and operations in the formal economy; and (2) strengthen the enterprise sector's capability to increase exports towards region and European Union (EU) markets. The project consists of the following three components: (1) Facilitating business entry and operations by improving quality of business regulations, including their potential impact on market competition; (2) Strengthening the enterprise sector's capability to export to regional and EU markets by developing further the Metrology, Standards, Testing and Quality system; and (3) Project coordination support component.

The overall objective of the BERIS is to assist the Government to: (i) facilitate business entry and operations in the formal economy; and (ii) strengthen the enterprise sector's capability to increase exports towards the region and EU markets.

At the same time, besides the 42 officials trained in the RIAtechniques under the consultancy financed by the project, other TA not included in the value included the following; (a)involvement of 23 of these 42 participants in 5 sessions for each of the three RIA pilots (drafting of the Inspection Law, Law onVeterinary Services and draft of the Environmental Protection Law; (b) promoting the implementation of light RIA in two workshopsin the last quarter of 2011 among 20 deputy ministers and general secretaries, 95 directors and heads of legal and policydepartments from all line ministries, leaders of independent institutions, and business people; (c) ongoing training of METE staffthat worked on the project (EVIS is this correct?).
